judge.label: LLM rubric score, fresh-context judge, self-assessed — not human QA.
judge.independence_caveat: This judge is a different model family and a fresh context: it saw only the judge prompt, the rubric and the lesson. It did not direct the project and did not author anything in it. It is still a language model scoring a language model's output, so the label applies: not human QA.

notes.knowledge_check: Distractors in PRV-01-KC-01 and PRV-01-KC-02 do not address real misconceptions and some feedback merely restates the stem rather than explaining why the option is incorrect.

verdict_notes: The lesson is well-aligned with its objectives and provides authentic scenarios and high-quality bilingual content. However, the knowledge checks contain distractors that are not based on real misconceptions and feedback that does not sufficiently address why incorrect options are wrong. One criterion scored below 4; mean score is 4.375. Passes, but improvements needed in knowledge checks.
